_meta.doc: Per-country area-code → admin-1 region mappings. Powers the per-country area-code quiz topics. Each entry: {name, intro, code_to_region: {code: regionName}, note (optional mnemonic per code)}. Region names must match the keys used in subregion_polygons.json so the click-on-map quiz can resolve them. Source-of-truth is the plonkit area-code map for each country.

KZ.name: Kazakhstan
KZ.intro: Kazakh area codes go 710-729. They roughly follow an east-to-west and north-to-south sweep — 71x covers the north + west, 72x covers the south + east.

notes.710: Newer code for Ulytau region (split from Qaraghandy in 2022). On Street View it usually still shows 721.
notes.711: Far west — Oral. Near Russian border.
notes.712: Atyrau on the Caspian. Oil capital.
notes.713: Aqtöbe — biggest western oblast. Soviet-era mining city.
notes.716: Aqmola — surrounds Astana but isn't the city itself.
notes.717: 🟢 Astana — capital city only (since 1997). Easy anchor.
notes.721: Karaganda — central, Kazakh USSR mining hub. Also still used in Ulytau region.
notes.722: Semey (Abai region) — east, near Russian border.
notes.723: Oskemen / East Kazakhstan — far east corner.
notes.724: Kyzylorda — south-central along Syr Darya, Aral Sea.
notes.725: Shymkent / South Kazakhstan / Turkestan — biggest southern city.
notes.726: Taraz / Zhambyl — south, Silk Road city.
notes.727: 🟢 Almaty city — former capital. The biggest city in Kazakhstan.
notes.728: Taldykorgan / Zhetysu / Almaty Region — east of the city.
notes.729: 🟢 Aktau / Mangystau — far southwest peninsula on Caspian. The only oblast on the SW peninsula.

KR.name: South Korea
KR.intro: Korean area codes increase from north (02) to south (064 = Jeju). Always 2 or 3 digits.

notes.02: 🟢 Seoul. The lowest code = the capital.
notes.064: 🟢 Jeju — the southern island. The HIGHEST code = furthest south.
